title: Vault Door Revelation
description: A young woman in steampunk attire stands inside a massive circular vault door with a wheel mechanism, looking back over her shoulder. The green metal door is partially open, revealing an interior filled with framed paintings, gears, and shelves, while the foreground shows a tiled floor with scattered ornate picture frames under a twilight sky.
prompt: A young woman with a red bandana and steampunk outfit stands inside a giant circular industrial vault door with heavy rivets and a wheel lock, looking back cautiously while holding the door open. The interior is filled with shelves of antique framed paintings, clocks, and mechanical gears. In the foreground, numerous ornate picture frames lean against walls on a tiled stone floor under a purple dusk sky, surreal and mysterious atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
